title: Universal Tax Payload
description: Standardized JSON payload expected by the eBIRForms Rust Application when syncing data from an external accounting or bookkeeping API.

tin.description: The 12-digit Taxpayer Identification Number, optionally including branch code.

target_form.description: Optional form code to force applicability (e.g. '2551Q', '1701Q').

period_start.description: Start date of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD).

period_end.description: End date of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD).

is_amended.description: Flag indicating if this payload is for an amended return.

income_sources.description: Array of income sources and revenues for the period.

is_vat_exempt.description: Flag indicating if the source is VAT-exempt.

atc.description: Optional Alphanumeric Tax Code (e.g., PT010) to map to a specific schedule line.

creditable_withholdings.description: Total amount of creditable withholding taxes (Form 2307) applicable for this period.

previous_tax_paid.description: Taxes previously paid for this same period (if amending).
